checks.evidence: Actual dimensions, prop positions, player spawn, colliders, lighting, and secret-door placement extracted from serialized YAML and recorded in .orchestrator/reports/2026-10-20-phase-2-layout-audit.md.

checks.name: Existing validation evidence
checks.evidence: Phase 1 greybox validation passed; existing captures reviewed. No new capture was needed for a read-only audit.

checks.name: Scope audit
checks.evidence: No Assets/Packages/ProjectSettings changes. Only documentation, task, report, and state files changed. Pre-existing untracked PackageManagerSettings.asset left untouched.

tasks.title: Add entrance door, storefront windows, and threshold
tasks.objective: Give the laundromat a readable street entrance and storefront glazing while preserving the existing south-wall opening, player spawn, and traversal.
acceptance: Entrance has a visible frame, door, threshold, and storefront windows
Player can still enter and leave through the doorway without collision traps
Facade blocks cannot be walked through or seen through incorrectly
Existing secret door, machine wall, counter, and folding table remain intact
Compile, EditMode, PlayMode, and greybox validation pass

checks.name: Scene compile and validation
checks.command: Unity batch compile; Phase2SetupTool.ValidateEntranceEnvelope; GreyboxSetupTool.ValidateGreyboxRoom; PlayerSetupTool.ValidatePlayerSetup
checks.evidence: All exit 0. TestResults/phase2-compile.log, phase2-validate.log, phase2-greybox-validate.log, phase2-player-validate.log. Doorway clear, window glass colliders hit, threshold <=0.05 m, secret door collider still enabled.

checks.name: EditMode and PlayMode suites
checks.evidence: EditMode 10/10 passed; PlayMode 9/9 passed after adding an entrance enter/leave traversal test. TestResults/phase2-editmode.xml, phase2-playmode.xml.

checks.name: Entrance capture review
checks.command: Phase2SetupTool.CaptureEntranceEnvelope without -nographics; inspect TestResults/phase2-entrance.png and phase2-storefront.png
checks.evidence: Exit 0; both captures inspected. Open glass door leaves, metal frame, flat threshold, two framed windows, and exterior backdrop are visible. Capture under -nographics crashed; rerun without it succeeded.

result.summary: Added a scoped storefront envelope to the existing greybox: south-wall window openings, frames and glass; an entrance frame with open glass leaves and a 0.05 m threshold; and a minimal exterior ground/backdrop. Existing room, counter, machines, folding table, lighting, and secret door were preserved.
result.notes: The tool is idempotent and additive; Laundromat scene geometry did not need a serialized diff because the prefab instance updated automatically. Rendering captures require graphics; do not use -nographics for CaptureEntranceEnvelope. Human facade review remains part of LL-P2-006.
